<div class="mp mpa">
<div class="mpa-hero">
<div class="mpa-brand">
<div class="mpa-title">开拓者1版中文维基</div>
<div class="mpa-sub">Pathfinder 1st Edition 的中文规则库，现有 <b>{{NUMBEROFARTICLES}}</b> 个条目</div>
</div>
<div class="mpa-search">
<inputbox>
type=search
width=40
placeholder=输入条目名，中文英文都行：火球术 · Power Attack · 巫妖
buttonlabel=查
searchbuttonlabel=全文搜索
break=no
</inputbox>
</div>
</div>

<div class="mpa-d" style="--pc:#8c5a4a"><div class="mpa-dh"><span class="mpi mpi-专长"></span>[[专长速查|专长]]<span class="mpa-n">{{PAGESINCATEGORY:专长|pages}}</span></div></div>

<div class="mpa-d" style="--pc:#4a6b7c"><div class="mpa-dh"><span class="mpi mpi-物品"></span>[[物品速查|物品]]<span class="mpa-n">{{PAGESINCATEGORY:物品|pages}}</span></div></div>

<div class="mpa-d" style="--pc:#4a7c6b"><div class="mpa-dh"><span class="mpi mpi-种族"></span>[[种族|种族]]<span class="mpa-n">{{PAGESINCATEGORY:种族|pages}}</span></div></div>
<div class="mpa-d" style="--pc:#56607c"><div class="mpa-dh"><span class="mpi mpi-神祇"></span>[[神祇速查|神祇]]<span class="mpa-n">{{PAGESINCATEGORY:神祇|pages}}</span></div></div>
<div class="mpa-d" style="--pc:#3f6b4a"><div class="mpa-dh"><span class="mpi mpi-怪物"></span>[[怪物速查|怪物]]<span class="mpa-n">{{PAGESINCATEGORY:怪物|pages}}</span></div></div>

<div class="mpa-d" style="--pc:#7b3f4f"><div class="mpa-dh">[[危害速查|危害]]<span class="mpa-n">{{PAGESINCATEGORY:危害|pages}}</span></div></div>

</div>
<div class="mpa-often"><span class="mpa-often-k">桌边速查</span>[[状态]][[战斗中的动作]][[特殊攻击|擒抱与战技]][[战斗修正]][[伤害和死亡]][[常用数据]][[术语对照表]]</div>
